caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with four curved drawers, each drawer adorned with two oval-shaped metal handles. The dresser stands on four short legs and has a marble top. Positioned centrally above the dresser is an ornate, oval-shaped mirror with an elaborate golden frame featuring floral and leaf motifs. On the marble top of the dresser, there are two tall candlesticks, one on each side, each holding a green candle, with both candlesticks appearing to be metallic and intricately designed. In between the candlesticks, a small, rectangular box with a patterned, multi-colored surface is placed centrally. The background is plain and unadorned, and the floor beneath the dresser is brown with visible wooden textures. The overall color scheme of the drawing consists of browns, golds, silvers, whites, and greens.
title: Chest of Drawers
